title: Receive what the Beloved gives
summary: Whatever pleases the Beloved comes to pass, and what is given is what the soul receives. Receive the moment under the One who gives, separates, and reunites.
takeaway: Receive the given moment under the One who gives and reunites.
lifeApplication: Before resistance rehearses its case, name what has been given and answer it with one act of trust instead of another argument.

source.shortMeaning: The soul receives under the Beloved’s pleasure, not under the ego’s demand for control.
source.lifeApplication: Name what has been given before resistance turns it into an argument.

evidence.coreClaim: The soul receives under the Beloved’s pleasure, not under the ego’s demand for control.
evidence.turn: The shabad places giving, receiving, separation, reunion, and service inside the Creator’s pleasure.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before resistance rehearses its case, name what has been given and answer it with one act of trust instead of another argument.
